title: service-impact-treemap-and-multi-dim-failure-categorizer
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Purpose: Build a multi-dimensional failure categorizer and service-impact treemap that unifies traces, metrics, and logs so SREs and platform engineers can quickly identify whether an SLO breach is due to timeouts, overload, model-level errors, or protocol-level (HTTP/gRPC) failures.

Scope:
- Add lightweight tracing hooks at router, batcher, and model-serving layers to capture failure_reason and enriched context (model_version, batch_size, kernel_profile, node_id, kv_cache_hit).
- Normalize failure taxonomy across sources into canonical fields: failure_origin, failure_mode, protocol_status, retryable, latency_bucket.
- Emit structured failure events into the telemetry pipeline (Kafka topic: telemetry.failures.v2), metrics into Prometheus (failure_counts{subsystem,mode,service}), and logs to the ELK ingestion stream with a consistent schema.
- Create Grafana treemap + heatmap dashboards that map service -> endpoint -> failure_mode and show SLO exposure, error rate, and median P99 latency side-by-side.

Acceptance criteria:
- Failure events contain the canonical fields and sample_trace_id with at least 1 sampled span for each failure category.
- Dashboards surface actionable drilldowns to trace and log context within 3 clicks.
- New metrics do not increase cardinality beyond acceptable limits (see telemetry-cost doc) and include aggregation knobs (by default aggregate to service and mode).
- We validate taxonomy across 10 days of historical traffic in staging and confirm >=95% classification coverage for errors observed in the last month.

Design decisions and trade-offs:
- We intentionally keep the failure taxonomy shallow (4 primary origins: client, network, runtime, model) to avoid explosion of labels and Prometheus cardinality. Detailed subtypes will be recorded as attributes in logs/Kafka for offline analysis.
- Tracing hook will add two string attributes to root span: failure_mode and failure_origin and a numeric protocol_status. Avoid adding large free-form error messages to spans to keep payloads small.
- Classification will be best-effort at source with fallback to offline enrichment: router/batcher make quick determinations (timeout vs overload vs protocol) and the enrichment pipeline attempts to reclassify ambiguous cases using trace spans and model-serving telemetry.

Instrumentation plan: (engineering checklist)
1) Router: attach failure_reason when upstream returns non-2xx or the backend signals 'MODEL_ERR' or 'THROTTLE'. Add span attributes: failure_mode, failure_origin, protocol_status, sampled_trace_id.
2) Batcher: emit a batch_failure metric for overload detection and set failure_mode=overload when queue_time > configured threshold. Add batch_size and preemptive_bump flags.
3) Model-runtime: map model-serving error codes to taxonomy (e.g., OOM -> runtime/overload, inference timeout -> model/timeout, tokenizer error -> model/error). Emit structured log for each model error with model_checksum and kernel_profile.
4) Telemetry pipeline: new Kafka topic telemetry.failures.v2 with Avro-like JSON schema (canonical fields). Ingest consumer enriches events with current canary model metadata and routes metric counters to Prometheus pushgateway for aggregation.

Dashboards and alerts:
- Grafana treemap by service shows weighted exposure (error-rate * request-volume) and clickable breakdown by mode.
- Heatmap of latency vs failure_mode to spot degradation patterns where timeouts cluster with spikes in batch size.
- New alert 'SLO: service failure mode surge' triggers when a service's error share for a given mode increases > 3x baseline and SLO exposure crosses 5% within 10m.

Rollout plan: staged rollout across environments: feature-flag tracing hooks, enable telemetry topic in staging for 48h, validate classification coverage, then gate rollout to canary region, monitor cost and cardinality for 72h before global rollout.

comments: 2025-11-13 - Maya Chen: Kickoff meeting notes attached, agreed to canonical fields list and rollout gating. Action: ENG infra to reserve Kafka topic and confirm retention policy.
2025-11-18 - Devon Singh: Implemented router span attributes and initial producer for telemetry.failures.v2. Added unit tests for attribute emission. Open PR: infra/telemetry-failure-v2 #4123.

2025-11-22 - SRE review (Liam Park): Feedback: prefer numeric enums for protocol_status to keep Prometheus friendly; suggest limiting label cardinality by aggregating to service and mode at ingestion. Marking as required change.

2025-11-25 - Devon Singh: Updated producer to emit protocol_status as integer and added an ingestion aggregation step to reduce label cardinality. Deployed to staging. Observed classification coverage of 87% on 48h sample; working to raise to target 95% via model-runtime tagging.

2025-11-28 - Design review (Priya Kaur): Dashboard mockups look good; requested an additional drilldown panel that surfaces recent model-version rollouts correlated with spikes. Approved the treemap layout.

2025-12-01 - Data eng (Ana Gomez): Ingestion consumer added enrichment job to map model checksums to release metadata. Noted a transient increase in Kafka throughput; retention and compaction settings adjusted.
